claims.title: Bounded exchange width characterizes uniformly bounded unbiased rounding

scoped_dependencies.relation: Related rounding scope only: N14 uses a small-mass cube interface with supplied signing machinery; N689 reports a general Boolean-polytope edge-width classification. No revision, implication, or N14 validation is asserted.

Related algorithmic scope only: N24 reports executable rational cube/partition-base procedures; N689 has a broader existential class but no efficient procedure. It does not close P-round or validate N24.
N692 is a source-derived algorithmic continuation for matroid bases only; it does not validate or algorithmize N689’s broader Boolean-polytope classification.

interface: For nonempty P=conv(V), V subset {0,1}^n, kappa(P) is the largest Hamming support of an actual edge. R(P) is the least uniform almost-sure discrepancy for exactly unbiased vertex distributions under Euclidean unit-column normalization.
limits: The claimed upper bound is existential via compact nonconvex minimization; no efficient sampler or general two-matroid guarantee is established.
status: source_derived_unreviewed; proof package, exact initiating prompt, standalone proof and diagnostics were not acquired or independently verified.
A separate N692 continuation reports a matroid-basis algorithm candidate; it does not validate or algorithmize the broader Boolean-polytope result.
